criteria_literal.G1:
El residual debe cerrar por debajo del 2 %. Se espera que OpAbsorption en
los volúmenes Vikuiti sea el componente dominante, y OpAbsorption en el
bulk del centellador el segundo. Si no cierra al 2 % con telemetría
completa, existe un tercer defecto no identificado.
criteria_literal.G2.1:
1. **Control positivo, gratis y obligatorio.** En el brazo B, el censo de
   fronteras del par AirGap*PV→Vikuiti*PV debe mostrar estados de
   reflexión ≥ 95 %. Si no los muestra, la fábrica dielectric_metal no
   está reflejando y el A/B no mide lo que dice medir: ABORTA la campaña
   y reporta.
criteria_literal.G2.2:
2. **Ganancia.** N_pe/end del brazo B dividido por el del brazo A debe
   caer entre 2 y 5. Fuera de esa banda se reporta como tal, sin ajustar.
criteria_literal.G2.3:
3. **Asimetría de mecanismo.** La ganancia en N_pe/end debe superar la
   ganancia en N_pe TOP total con razón mayor que 1,5. Si ambos suben por
   igual, el mecanismo no es el rescate de fotones no-TIR.
criteria_literal.G2.4:
4. **Convergencia con el deck.** El valor de referencia es
   \NapNpesimejB = 941 pe/end (EJ-204, x=0). Si el brazo B cae entre 800 y
   1100, los dos defectos explican la totalidad del déficit histórico.
   Fuera de ese intervalo, queda un efecto residual por identificar.

preregistration.G1_definition: 100 * abs(scint_generated - sum(scintillation terminal categories))/scint_generated < 2; identity anomalies or mismatch with independently counted scintillation starts invalidate complete closure. Unknown is retained as a category, separately quantified. Rank OpAbsorption volumes among all terminal components and within OpAbsorption.
preregistration.G2_reflection_denominator: Forward matched AirGap{YMinus,ZPlus,ZMinus}PV to Vikuiti{same}PV only. Exclude Undefined,NotAtBoundary,SameMaterial,StepTooSmall; retain all excluded counts. Reflection=names ending Reflection or BackScattering. Pass if aggregate AND each panel >=95 percent; zero denominator fails. Reverse direction is never mixed.
preregistration.uncertainty: Event sample SEM, including all generated event IDs and zeros. B/A ratio SEM by delta method assuming independent arms; covariance not measured despite equal seeds. No binomial uncertainty on correlated encounters.
preregistration.position_test: Report per-position gain and delta-method uncertainty. Fit weighted constant and gain=a+b*abs(x) at six N=1000 positions; report slope +/- SE and chi-square/dof. A positive slope exceeding two SE is evidence of growth; otherwise growth is not established, not proof of flatness. x=0 N=2000 shown separately.
preregistration.time_rule: After first N=2000 cell, project Block 3 as 6*wall_s and total planned simulation as 8*wall_s plus C0. If total >7h, drop both +/-650 then +/-200; never reduce N. Reassess conservatively using both measured arm rates when available.
